section .text
global _start

_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, msg
    mov rdx, 13
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

section .data
msg: db "Hello, world", 10

; sum the first rdi integers, return in rax
sum_n:
    xor rax, rax
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rdi
    jg .done
    add rax, rcx
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

; strlen(rdi) -> rax
strlen:
    xor rax, rax
.next:
    cmp byte [rdi + rax], 0
    je .done
    inc rax
    jmp .next
.done:
    ret

; memcpy(rdi=dst, rsi=src, rdx=len)
memcpy:
    test rdx, rdx
    jz .done
    mov rcx, rdx
    cld
    rep movsb
.done:
    ret

; factorial(rdi) -> rax, recursive
fact:
    cmp rdi, 1
    jle .base
    push rdi
    dec rdi
    call fact
    pop rdi
    imul rax, rdi
    ret
.base:
    mov rax, 1
    ret

; fibonacci(rdi) -> rax, iterative
fib:
    xor rax, rax
    mov rcx, 1
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
.loop:
    add rax, rcx
    xchg rax, rcx
    dec rdi
    jnz .loop
.done:
    ret

; max(rdi, rsi) -> rax, branchless
max:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rax, rsi
    cmovl rax, rsi
    ret

; popcount(rdi) -> rax
popcount:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
    mov rcx, rdi
    dec rcx
    and rdi, rcx
    inc rax
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

; swap two i64 pointed to by rdi and rsi
swap_i64:
    mov rax, [rdi]
    mov rcx, [rsi]
    mov [rdi], rcx
    mov [rsi], rax
    ret

; reverse byte array in place: rdi=ptr, rsi=len
reverse:
    test rsi, rsi
    jz .done
    lea rcx, [rdi + rsi - 1]
.loop:
    cmp rdi, rcx
    jge .done
    mov al, [rdi]
    mov dl, [rcx]
    mov [rdi], dl
    mov [rcx], al
    inc rdi
    dec rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

; gcd(rdi, rsi) -> rax, Euclidean
gcd:
    mov rax, rdi
.loop:
    test rsi, rsi
    jz .done
    xor rdx, rdx
    div rsi
    mov rax, rsi
    mov rsi, rdx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

; clamp(rdi=val, rsi=lo, rdx=hi) -> rax
clamp:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rax, rsi
    cmovl rax, rsi
    cmp rax, rdx
    cmovg rax, rdx
    ret
